method.ageRaceEducationIncome: 2024 ACS PUMS joint individual records, restricted to voting-age citizens and reweighted to 2024 validated-voter benchmarks.
method.religion: State religion margins raked to rounded 2023-24 Pew Religious Landscape shares; individual assignments are conditional on race, age, education, and state.
method.ideology: State ideology margins preserve state patterns while matching recent national self-identification benchmarks; individual assignments are conditional on race, education, age, and religion.
method.party: Individual two-party lean combines 2024 validated-voter group relationships with demographic and ideological predictors, then centers to 50% nationally.
method.policy: Each agent receives 19 correlated issue positions from ideology, religion, demographics, and shared economic/social/foreign-policy axes. State-by-issue position margins are calibrated to the game’s existing policy baseline.
method.weighting: Each agent is an equal-weight systematic sample within its state; state agent counts use largest-remainder apportionment from official 2024 state ballot totals.
